meta.src:
schema: playbook/2
name: solution_aTFrQkQDgvp7m17er_playbook_ak4qf
title: Re-enrich Threat Intelligence
description: 'Flow triggers when last_seen is changed, flow will re-enrich the TIA. '
actions:
  Get_Timestamp_Expired:
    title: Get Timestamp Expired
    type: transformation
    description: ""
    on-success:
    - If_Timestamp_Expired: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    transformations:
      hours_old:
        title: Hours Old
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        inputs:
          expression: "(\n  $now_ms := $toMillis($now());\n  $raw_time := event.data.record.values.'ti-last-updated';\n  $fallback_ms := $now_ms - 86400000;\n  \n  $start_ms := $exists($raw_time) and $raw_time != \"\"\n    ? $toMillis($contains($raw_time, /Z|[+-]\\d{2}:?\\d{2}/) ? $raw_time : $raw_time & \"Z\") \n    : $fallback_ms;\n    \n  $diff_ms := $now_ms - $start_ms;\n  $diff_ms / 3600000\n)"
          data:
            event:
              data:
                record:
                  values:
                    $:ref: $event.data.record.values
        actionType: jsonata
        next: timestamp_expired
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
      timestamp_expired:
        title: Timestamp Expired
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        inputs:
          expression: >-
            (
                $rehydration_hours := assets.AI_SOC_Threat_Intelligence_Configuration.TIA_Record_Verdict_Enrichment_Rehydration_Hours ;
                $timestamp_hours_old := actions.Get_Timestamp_Expired.result.hours_old ;

                ($timestamp_hours_old >= $rehydration_hours)
            )
          data:
            assets:
              assets:
                AI_SOC_Threat_Intelligence_Configuration:
                  TIA_Record_Verdict_Enrichment_Rehydration_Hours:
                    $:ref: $assets.AI_SOC_Threat_Intelligence_Configuration.TIA_Record_Verdict_Enrichment_Rehydration_Hours
              AI_SOC_Threat_Intelligence_Configuration:
                TIA_Record_Verdict_Enrichment_Rehydration_Hours:
                  $:ref: $assets.AI_SOC_Threat_Intelligence_Configuration.TIA_Record_Verdict_Enrichment_Rehydration_Hours
            actions:
              Get_Timestamp_Expired:
                result:
                  hours_old:
                    $:ref: $actions.Get_Timestamp_Expired.result.hours_old
        actionType: jsonata
        next: observable_array
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
      observable_array:
        title: Observable Array
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        inputs:
          expression: '[event.data.record.values.observable]'
          data:
            event:
              data:
                record:
                  values:
                    observable:
                      $:ref: $event.data.record.values.observable
        actionType: jsonata
        next: ""
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
    entrypoint: hours_old
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  If_Timestamp_Expired:
    title: If Timestamp Expired
    type: conditional
    description: ""
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    conditions:
    - action: Mark_TIA_Record_Requires_Enrichment
      condition:
        $:and:
        - - $:ref: $actions.Get_Timestamp_Expired.result.timestamp_expired
          - $:eq: true
    else: ""
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 3fbb8841-b6bf-4076-ab64-897801b7b6a8
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  Mark_TIA_Record_Requires_Enrichment:
    title: Mark TIA Record Requires Enrichment
    type: recordAction
    description: ""
    on-success:
    - Enrich_Observable: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    inputs:
      applicationId: aGfR2rPsFvQq4lBU_
      patchValues:
        requires-reenrichment: "True"
      restrictions:
        groups:
          operation: append
          value: []
        users:
          operation: append
          value: []
      trackingId: "{ $:ref: $event.data.record.values['tracking-id'] }"
      applicationName: ""
      removeValues: {}
      appendValues: {}
    recordActionType: patch
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 3a2386b7-1a22-48ca-9360-8f2bc0e82605
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  Enrich_Observable:
    title: Enrich Observable
    type: connector
    description: ""
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete:
    - Upsert_TIA_Record: {}
    publish: {}
    action: $playbook.component_aVrs_AryfuuzSkEMB_playbook
    inputs:
      observable:
        observable_type: "{ $:ref: $event.data.record.values['observable-type'] }"
        observable_value: '{ $:ref: $event.data.record.values.observable }'
        observable_file:
          $:ref: $event.data.record.values['observable-file']
    pool: $default
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    asset: ""
    environment: {}
    testInputs: {}
  Upsert_TIA_Record:
    title: Upsert TIA Record
    type: recordAction
    description: ""
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    inputs:
      applicationId: aGfR2rPsFvQq4lBU_
      patchValues:
        ti-last-updated: '{ $:ref: $actions.Enrich_Observable.result.published.intelligence_last_updated }'
        requires-reenrichment: "False"
        threat-intelligence-verdict: '{ $:ref: $actions.Enrich_Observable.result.published.risk_score_verdict }'
        turbine-risk-score:
          $:ref: $actions.Enrich_Observable.result.published.turbine_risk_score
        merged-risk-scores:
          $:ref: $actions.Enrich_Observable.result.published.merged_risk_scores
        enrichments:
          $:ref: $actions.Enrich_Observable.result.published.enrichments
      restrictions:
        groups:
          operation: append
          value: []
        users:
          operation: append
          value: []
      trackingId: "{ $:ref: $event.data.record.values['tracking-id'] }"
      applicationName: ""
      removeValues: {}
      appendValues: {}
    recordActionType: patch
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 42f46e85-0c34-4954-84ac-94c982f7855c
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
triggers:
  records:
  - abh96:
      if:
        $:and:
        - - $:ref: $event.data.record.values['last-seen']
          - $:neq: "{ $:ref: $event.data.previous.values['last-seen'] }"
          - ignoreCase: true
entrypoints:
- Get_Timestamp_Expired
meta:
  enabled: true
namespace: $default
pool: ""
timeout: 0
publish: {}
environment: {}
inputs:
  type: object
